n, k, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 250001
fac = [1] * (N)
inv = [1] * (N)
ifac = [1] * (N)

for i in range(2, N):
    inv[i] = (mod // i) * (mod - inv[mod % i]) % mod
    fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % mod
    ifac[i] = ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod

ans = pow(k, n, mod)

if n % 2 == 0:
    f = [[0] * 27 for _ in range(n + 1)]
    f[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if (n & i) == i:
            msk = i - (i & -i)
            j = msk
            while True:
                len_ = min(k - 1, bin(j).count('1'))
                for t in range(len_ + 1):
                    f[i][t + 1] = (f[i][t + 1] + f[j][t] * ifac[i - j]) % mod
                if j == 0:
                    break
                j = (j - 1) & msk
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        ans = (ans - f[n][i] * fac[n] % mod * fac[k] % mod * ifac[k - i]) % mod

print((ans + mod) % mod)
